name: architecture.data-flow
observations: User opens app → app.init() → storageService.init() → loads userPreferences from IndexedDB
init() uses geoService → gets coordinates (geolocation or stored/search fallback)
weatherFetcher.fetchWeatherData(lat, lon) → WeatherService fetches Open-Meteo forecast + AQI with fetch()
Raw response → DataProcessor.processData(forecastData, aqiData) → transforms into state.hourlyData[] and state.dailyData[]
processData also generates daily cards and saves past history via storageService.setHistory()
Render triggered by scroll event → render() → iterates visible tiles → drawTile() for each uncached tile
Scroll also calls updateTopPanel(), drawFixedOverlay(), updateMinimapViewport()
User interactions (click/scrub/resize) → event handlers → state mutation → re-render

name: architecture.canvas-layers
observations: Three overlaid canvas layers in #chart-area, ordered bottom→top via CSS z-index/absolute positioning
Layer 1 (main-canvas): tiled background + grid + weather phenomena + metric layers — drawn to offscreen tile canvases
Layer 2 (fixed-overlay-canvas): scrubber labels, NOW indicator, stickman — redrawn every frame on animation loop
Layer 3 (stickman-canvas): animated stickman figure reacting to weather conditions
Each layer uses horizontal tiling; only visible tiles rendered per frame based on scrollLeft

name: architecture.tiling
observations: TILE_WIDTH = 1440px (hardcoded in CONFIG), overridden to 720px on mobile <600px width
state.PIXELS_PER_HOUR = 60 (desktop ≥600px) or 50 (mobile <600px)
numTiles = ceil(totalWidth / TILE_WIDTH)
tileCache: Map<string, HTMLCanvasElement> keyed by date string
renderAndCacheVisibleTiles(scrollLeft) computes visible tile range and draws uncached tiles
renderChartArea() composites relevant layers into the visible canvas area
On scroll: cached tiles reused from tileCache, only new tiles rendered

name: architecture.minimap
observations: MinimapRenderer class manages its own canvas (#minimap-canvas) and minimapCacheCanvas
MINIMAP_HEIGHT = 80px (CONFIG)
Auto-switches between 'past' and 'future' mode based on scroll position relative to current time index
Includes viewport indicator (blue rectangle showing current visible range)
Click-to-scroll navigation: clicking on minimap scrolls chart to that position
Mode toggle button switches between past-only and full-range views

name: architecture.key-constants
observations: CONFIG (src/store.js): CHART_HEIGHT:250, MINIMAP_HEIGHT:80, TILE_WIDTH:1440, CACHE_DURATION:300000ms (5 min), PIXELS_PER_MM:10, DEFAULT_COORDS:{lat:40.4167,lon:-3.70325,name:'Madrid'}
state.PIXELS_PER_HOUR: 60 (desktop) or 50 (mobile <600px) — computed in app.js init
state.viewMode: switches between 'temperature', 'humidity', 'wind', 'precipitation'
state.theme: one of 'default', 'neon', 'pastel' — loaded from public/themes/{id}.json
state.selectedDay: currently selected day index for rendering focus
state.language: 'es' or 'en' — persists in StorageService

name: architecture.services
observations: WeatherFetcher (domain/): Cache-based fetch orchestrator with 5-min TTL; falls back to MockData on API failure
WeatherService: Open-Meteo API client for hourly forecast + European AQI; singleton pattern
DataProcessor: Transforms raw API JSON → state.hourlyData[] (per-hour metrics) + state.dailyData[] (per-day aggregates); saves history via StorageService
GeoService: Geocoding (city→coords) via Open-Meteo Geocoding API + reverse geocoding (coords→name) via OpenStreetMap Nominatim with 2s request queue
StorageService: IndexedDB abstraction with localStorage fallback; stores userPreferences + historyData
FavoritesService: CRUD persistence layer for saved location favorites
AqiManager: AQI value→level/color/description classification + pollen level thresholds for 6 species
MockData: Synthetic weather data generator for offline/error fallback

Exports frozen CONFIG: CHART_HEIGHT:250, MINIMAP_HEIGHT:80, TILE_WIDTH:1440, CACHE_DURATION:300000, PIXELS_PER_MM:10, DEFAULT_COORDS:{lat:40.4167,lon:-3.70325,name:'Madrid'}
state.PIXELS_PER_HOUR computed dynamically: 60 (desktop) or 50 (mobile)

name: src/app.js
observations: Main entry point, orchestrates ~30 init functions for services, UI, renderers

Defines render(), renderAndCacheVisibleTiles(), renderChartArea(), renderDates()
Manages tileCache Map, 3 canvas layers (chartCanvas, overlayCanvas, stickmanCanvas)
Handles window resize, orientation change, visibility change events

name: MinimapTemperatureLabels
observations: SDD Phase 4 IMPLEMENT completed
Extrema detection with plateau handling (first-of-plateau)
Significance filter: cumulative diff >= 5°C from last kept
Collision avoidance: min 40px between labels
Peaks above curve (-10px Y offset), valleys below (+12px)
Y clamped to [4, height-4]
Visual: bold 9px font, white shadow halo, peaks red/valleys blue
Version bumped to 1.16.0, CHANGELOG.md and changelog.js updated, index.html and version.json patched
E2E visual snapshots regenerated: full-chart.png, minimap.png, daily-cards.png, theme-dark.png, theme-light.png
Unified colors: both peaks and valleys now use getThemeColor('tempLine', '#d32f2f')
Reduced peak offset from -10 to -4 (closer to curve)
Reduced valley offset from +12 to +5 (closer to curve)
Added adaptive flip: peak near top edge draws below with textBaseline='top'; valley near bottom draws above with textBaseline='bottom'
Root cause of 'not drawing on peaks' bug: -10px offset with textBaseline='bottom' pushed labels above canvas for temps > ~27°C (yRaw < 14)
filterSignificant() cascade bug fixed: now compares each extremum against its raw predecessor (prevTemp), not the last kept extremum (fixes issue where peaks went unlabeled in alternating patterns)
tempLabelRenderer.draw() moved after past overlay in MinimapRenderer.draw() so temperature labels are visible in past mode
Verification passed: npm test 423/423, lint 0 errors, typecheck clean, build success

filterSignificant() updated: threshold changed from 5°C to 3°C, added auto-keep logic (if previous extremum was skipped by threshold, current is automatically kept regardless of temp difference) — prevents cascade effect where multiple consecutive extrema were filtered out

Collision avoidance changed to per-type: 'lastDrawnMaxX' and 'lastDrawnMinX' tracked independently — same-type labels must be ≥ 40px apart, but alternating peak/valley labels always draw since they're on opposite sides of the line
detectExtrema() now uses Math.round(d.temp) for all comparisons and stores rounded values
New method deduplicateSameType(): if two consecutive extrema are same type, keeps the more extreme one (higher max / lower min) — fixes false peaks on rising trends without valleys
Verified: 424/424 tests pass, lint 0, typecheck clean, build success

Documentation updated: CHANGELOG.md, src/data/changelog.js (threshold 5→3, test count 423→424, added new behaviors), specs/render/MinimapTemperatureLabels.md (full v3 spec update with auto-keep, per-type collision, deduplicateSameType, Math.round, labels after past overlay)
